service_boundary: Represents the mainland platform operated at bigmodel.cn by a Chinese entity, not the separately operated Z.ai Model API, the open-weight model releases, or Zhipu's consumer assistant.
regional_controls: One public endpoint with no customer-selectable region. The privacy policy states that personal information collected in mainland operations is stored in mainland China with no current cross-border transfer. Private instances add virtual-network and allowlist access control.
retention_controls: Customers own uploaded data and the platform commits to no unauthorised use or disclosure and to minimum-necessary storage. Customer-initiated deletion triggers a product-specific buffer period after which caches and backups are removed irreversibly. There is no blanket commitment against training: anonymised data may be used for machine-learning and model-algorithm training without separate consent.
routing: Customers select a model identifier. Rate limiting is concurrency-based per model and tiered by benefit level and subscription, adjusted dynamically at peak. No cross-provider routing or documented fallback.
customization: Fine-tuning and evaluation are documented, with private instance deployment of tuned versions and configurable inference settings. Customer-supplied weights are not documented.
strengths: Compatible surfaces for two major client conventions sit alongside the native interface on one documented host.
Deletion is specified concretely as a buffer period followed by irreversible removal of cached and backup copies.
Personal information from mainland operations is stated to stay in mainland China with no current cross-border transfer.
tradeoffs: No blanket commitment against training; anonymised data may be used for model-algorithm training without separate consent.
A single public endpoint with no customer-selectable region and no documented reserved-capacity tier.
The service agreement carries no date or version, unlike the user agreement and privacy policy.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Zhipu open platform API documentation, for the Zhipu AI Open Platform

upstream_disclosure.note: The privacy policy states the operator receives and processes inputs: "您可以自愿在大模型开放平台内试用我们的模型……您可以向我们提供文本对话信息、图片信息、音频信息、文档信息以及其他输入信息（以下称“输入信息”）" (you may provide text, image, audio, document, and other input information, from which the platform generates content). No subprocessor is named.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Zhipu open platform privacy policy, for the Zhipu AI Open Platform

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: the quick-start says "登录后，在个人中心页面，点击 API Keys，创建一个新的 API Key。" (after logging in, create a new API key on the personal centre page) and every documented request uses that key.
credential_handling.scope: Zhipu open platform quick-start, for the Zhipu AI Open Platform

cache_isolation.note: The cache guide documents the feature and its billing but never states whether a cache is scoped to the account that created it.
cache_isolation.scope: Zhipu open platform cache guide, for the Zhipu AI Open Platform

vulnerability_disclosure.note: No security contact or disclosure policy is published: the security-audit guide concerns content moderation, the security page and security.txt paths serve only an application shell, and the only contact found is a content-reporting channel.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Zhipu open platform security-audit guide, for the Zhipu AI Open Platform

independent_audit.note: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent attestation is named in the privacy policy, the terms, or the platform documentation.
independent_audit.scope: Zhipu open platform privacy policy, for the Zhipu AI Open Platform
